heroSummary: The Bambu Lab X1C handles Sunlu PLA+ 2.0 straight out of the box with exceptional reliability, pushing throughput to a safe maximum print speed of 286 mm/s at a 24 mm³/s volumetric flow limit. While the stock hardened steel nozzle easily processes this non-abrasive blend, keeping the top glass vented is essential during high-speed printing to prevent heat creep.
bedSurfaceRecommendation: Textured PEI Plate (clean with IPA/dish soap, no adhesive required)
slicerTweaks: Set Filament Max Volumetric Speed to 24 mm³/s in the filament profile to cap outer/inner feeds at the calculated 286 mm/s limit.
Fix printing temperature to 218°C across all layers to ensure consistent melt rheology at high print velocities.
Calibrate Flow Dynamics (Pressure Advance) using the Micro Lidar or manual line method, targeting a K-value between 0.020 and 0.026.
Set the Chamber Fan to 70% or activate 'Keep fan always on' with a 4-second minimum layer time to avoid thermal softening in delicate features.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Extruder clicking and mid-print clogging (Heat Creep)
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Chamber ambient temperature rising above 40°C due to fully enclosed printing, causing PLA+ 2.0 to soften inside the cold zone.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Prop open the top glass cover using a printed riser or leave the front glass door cracked open during prints longer than 45 minutes.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Gloss/matte surface banding on outer perimeters
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Fluctuating flow velocity where the slicer throttles speed between fast infill and slow outer features, changing polymer crystallization.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Standardize Outer Wall Speed to 150-180 mm/s and ensure the inner-to-outer transition does not drop below 120 mm/s.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Corner lifting on the side facing the auxiliary fan
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Bambu auxiliary cooling fan blowing unilateral cold air across the build plate, causing uneven thermal contraction.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Reduce the auxiliary part cooling fan to 30% or turn it off completely in the filament cooling tab, maintaining 60°C on the bed.

faq.question: Can I print Sunlu PLA+ 2.0 with the Bambu Lab X1C door and lid fully closed?
faq.answer: It is not recommended for prints lasting more than 30-45 minutes. The internal chamber temperature quickly reaches 40-45°C, softening PLA+ prematurely in the extruder gears and causing severe heat creep jams.

faq.question: What is the recommended Pressure Advance (K-value) for Sunlu PLA+ 2.0 on the X1C?
faq.answer: Using the stock 0.4mm hardened steel nozzle, Sunlu PLA+ 2.0 typically tunes between 0.020 and 0.026. Running the X1C automatic Micro Lidar calibration produces reliable results.

faq.question: Does Sunlu PLA+ 2.0 require drying before printing on the X1C?
faq.answer: PLA+ is not strongly hygroscopic, but fresh spools can retain surface moisture from water-cooling baths during manufacturing. Drying at 45-50°C for 4 hours will eliminate stringing and improve seam quality.

faq.question: Why does Sunlu PLA+ 2.0 achieve higher volumetric flow than standard PLA?
faq.answer: The 'Plus' formulation includes impact modifiers and melt flow enhancers that lower viscosity under shear, permitting up to 24 mm³/s without skipping steps on the direct drive extruder.
